items.briefing:
Australian investors are being warned to watch out for AI-generated deepfake scams after ASIC raised the alarm about increasingly convincing fake investment networks. These scams use realistic video and audio to impersonate trusted figures, making them harder to spot. Separately, a China-linked hacker group has demonstrated advanced AI capabilities in attacks targeting the Asia-Pacific region, a reminder that Australian organisations remain within the crosshairs of sophisticated state-backed threats.

A critical vulnerability in GitLab also requires attention from any organisation using the platform, as the zero-click flaw requires no user interaction to exploit.

**Tip:** If you receive an unsolicited investment opportunity online — even featuring a recognisable face or voice — verify it through official channels before engaging.

featured.title: OpenAI rolls out ChatGPT for Teens with safety in Australia
featured.summary: Teen users in Australia will now default to a safer ChatGPT with study tools, parental controls and tighter limits on sensitive content.
